import ast
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import sqlite3

root = pathlib.Path('.')
files = ['001_initial.sql', '002_up.sql', '002_down.sql', 'old_reader.py', 'new_reader.py', 'release.md']
before = {f: hashlib.sha256((root / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}
queries = {}
for f in ['old_reader.py', 'new_reader.py']:
    tree = ast.parse((root / f).read_text())
    queries[f] = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'QUERY' for t in n.targets))

def inspect(db, state):
    print('\nSTATE:', state)
    print('schema:', db.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='users'").fetchone()[0])
    for reader, query in queries.items():
        try:
            print(reader, json.dumps(db.execute(query).fetchall()))
        except sqlite3.Error as exc:
            print(reader, type(exc).__name__ + ':', str(exc))

print('Python SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('Loaded supplied queries:', json.dumps(queries))
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
db.executescript((root / '001_initial.sql').read_text())
db.executemany('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', [(1, 'Alice'), (2, 'Bob')])
db.commit()
inspect(db, 'initial (seeded)')
db.executescript((root / '002_up.sql').read_text())
inspect(db, 'up (old instances still serving during rollout)')
print('\nSynthetic new-schema writes; no application writer code was supplied:')
db.execute('UPDATE users SET display_name = ? WHERE id = ?', ('Alice updated — 새 이름', 1))
db.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, display_name) VALUES (?, ?)', (3, 'Carol new'))
db.commit()
print('Committed update id=1 and insert id=3; id=2 untouched.')
inspect(db, 'up after committed writes (also old-binary-first rollback window)')
pre_down = db.execute('SELECT id, display_name FROM users ORDER BY id').fetchall()
db.executescript((root / '002_down.sql').read_text())
inspect(db, 'down after writes')
post_down = db.execute('SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY id').fetchall()
assert post_down == pre_down, (pre_down, post_down)
assert post_down == [(1, 'Alice updated — 새 이름'), (2, 'Bob'), (3, 'Carol new')]
print('PASS: updated value, untouched row, inserted row and IDs all survive down unchanged.')
print('Integrity:', db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
after = {f: hashlib.sha256((root / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}
assert before == after
print('PASS: all six supplied release files unchanged (SHA-256 compared).')

    tree = ast.parse(pathlib.Path(version + '_reader.py').read_text())
    queries[version] = ast.literal_eval(tree.body[0].value)
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')

def observe(stage):
    print('\nSTATE:', stage)

        try:
            print(version, repr(query), '=>', db.execute(query).fetchall())
        except sqlite3.Error as e:

db.executemany('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', [(1, 'Alice'), (2, 'Unchanged')])
db.commit()
observe('initial; old active')
db.executescript(pathlib.Path('002_up.sql').read_text())
observe('up; old remains active, then old/new mixed rollout')

db.executescript(pathlib.Path('002_down.sql').read_text())
observe('down after old-first rollback')
actual = db.execute('SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY id').fetchall()
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
print('\nPASS: updated existing row, unchanged row, and newly inserted row survive down exactly')
assert before == {p: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
print('PASS: all six release files unchanged')
